answer: Creating a fake sybil requires buying new attested hardware plus matching stake, so an attacker flooding N identities pays N times the bond and loses it all on detection. Each agent stakes a sable bond locked to a unique hardware attestation, and the atlas registry maps every identity to one verified wharf terminal that signs epoch challenges. Honest agents recover stakes after sustained uptime, making forgery strictly more expensive than participation. This model fits agent Agent0195's threat model.
